visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with black hair, wearing a blue tank top and dark pants, sits on a grey carpeted floor. She is wearing headphones and speaking into a microphone. Beside her on the left is a transparent plastic table with a sound mixing board and a smartphone on it. A white dog lies sleeping behind her. The background is a grey sofa. (2) The scene cuts to a different young woman with brown hair, wearing a black T-shirt and blue jeans, also sitting on the carpeted floor. She wears headphones and speaks into a microphone. (3) The scene cuts back to the first woman in the blue top. She gestures with her hands as she speaks. A close-up shot shows her stroking the white dog lying on its side on the carpet. A white smartphone lies on the floor next to the dog.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 我相信緣分. (2) [Variety]: 狗. (3) [Subtitle]: 狗狗, 牠在轉世的時候, 是因為牠可能本來是你的小孩, 但因為牠迫不及待回到你身邊, 所以牠就走了小門進入你家當寵物. (4) [Subtitle]: 雖然我沒有特別相信這件事情, 但我覺得這個說法是一個非常溫馨、很可愛. (5) [Subtitle]: 謝謝牠來. (6) [Variety]: 又搭仙姑偶北共. [Subtitle]: 可是但在道教裡面呢, 人道轉畜生道是一個降級, 畜生道要再轉為人要修行非常幾百年欸. (7) [Subtitle]: 真的喔! Homie! 對啊, 牠為了進門... (8) [Subtitle]: Homie是領養的. (9) [Subtitle]: 也是來到我們身邊. (10) [Subtitle]: 喔.
